method: No number. About 1 in 100 NPC melee hits and 1 to 3 in 100 NPC gun hits reach the head, so a helmet is mostly protection from players who aim there, and they aim at whichever of head and chest is weaker. So plain helmet armor (same as a basic vest) is green; bullet or laser 50 and up, or a pressure seal on top of real armor, is yellow; top numbers that go with a top suit, or an effect that changes a fight by itself, are red; authored one-offs are above. A seal only works with a sealed suit, so sealed helmets lean on the suit they go with, and hoods are rated with their suit.
